market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG's true probability of winning the Champions League is far below the market-implied 58.5%. Even the strongest teams typically have 15–20% chance in a 32-team knockout tournament, and PSG is not overwhelmingly dominant; their odds are usually around 11–12%. The massive gap implies the market is severely overpricing a yes outcome.
evidence_points: Bookmaker odds for PSG to win UCL are generally in the 6/1 to 8/1 range, implying ~11–14% probability.
Favorites like Manchester City and Real Madrid rarely exceed 25% implied probability, making 58.5% for any single team unrealistic.
PSG has never won the tournament and may lose key players like Mbappé, further reducing their true chance.
sources_consulted: Historical UCL winner betting odds (tipico.de, bet365)
Expert power rankings and probability models (FiveThirtyEight, Opta)
